chapter: Virginia school and first Washington bands
title: St. Emma's School in Virginia and its band
summary: At 14 he went to a school near Richmond that had a band, where he began playing trombone.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Yeah, I went to school in Virginia about 40 miles out of -- I had been fooling around with a trombone a little bit around Savannah then. I went to this school
and they had a band there. It was called St. Emma's School, Rock Castle, Virginia, about 40 miles out of Richmond, Virginia. I went there in '26.
